answers.reason: The record explicitly states in paragraph 2 that an 'unregistered deed of lease' was executed, which is a direct finding of fact rather than a party claim or contrary evidence.

evidence.quote: An unregis- tered deed of lease was executed on that occasion

answers.reason: The lease deed contains a specific clause granting written permission to assign or part with possession to an 'associate concern,' which the court accepted as admissible for collateral purposes despite the deed's non-registration.

evidence.quote: That they will not assign or underlet or part with the premises hereby demised without the permission in writing of the landlord subject however to this proviso that they shall be entitled to assign or otherwise part with the possession of the said premises or any part thereof to their associate concerns

the document may not be admissible for the purpose of proving the existence of a lease or the terms thereof, but as the afore-mentioned clause does not come within that category, in as much as, it merely amounts to a written permission to the appellant to create a sub-lease, it can not be excluded from consideration on the ground of non- registration

answers.reason: The record contains no named lower-court finding that the tenant parted with possession; the court only notes the eviction order was based on subletting, which is not a finding that the tenant himself parted with possession.

evidence.quote: ordered eviction on the ground that M/s. United Automobiles was inducted in the premises as a sub-lessee
